diagnostic_definitions.timestamp_search: Explicit point requests require actual sampled visual timestamps within the predeclared tolerance, linked to final citations. Range requests require cited, modality-compatible source observations in every required reference support, and all cited/source intervals and observed frames inside the requested range. Transcript cases use cue intervals, not visual frames. Requested timestamps alone are never observations. Unknown telemetry remains null; known missing/error/abstention is failure. These are temporal compliance diagnostics, not semantic answer correctness or continuous range coverage.
diagnostic_definitions.semantic_review_coverage: A named review is present only with reviewer and method. Complete atom reviews require boolean correct/supported for every required atom plus extra_claims_supported; event review completeness requires event_identity_correct; negative controls require abstention_correct. Missing/error/abstained task outputs can have known zero task scores without being reviewed. Legacy accuracy_known therefore includes automatic failures and is not reviewed answer quality. semantic_reviewed_only includes only complete named semantic reviews, stays null with zero reviews, and reports its denominator alongside coverage.
diagnostic_definitions.retrieval: Candidates follow chronological search calls and returned rank; duplicate physical regions are removed. Recall@k is the maximum one-to-one fraction of required supports matched in the first k unique candidates. A hit requires compatible known modality and either an actual sampled timestamp in the reference interval or interval IoU>=0.3. These are localization diagnostics, not semantic correctness.
diagnostic_definitions.reciprocal_rank: Inverse rank of the first candidate matching any required support; zero for a recorded search with no relevant hit. Questions without required supports or without a recorded search have null retrieval metrics.
diagnostic_definitions.ndcg_at_5: Binary unique-support gain, discounted by log2(rank+1). At most one previously unmatched support earns gain for each candidate (highest geometric score breaks ambiguity); ideal DCG contains min(5, number of required supports) gains. Repeated evidence for the same support cannot increase gain.
diagnostic_definitions.citation_geometry: Unique final citation intervals with known/inferred-from-ledger modality are matched to required supports at interval IoU>=0.3. Precision counts matching citations divided by unique valid citations plus invalid citations. Support recall uses one-to-one assignment. Unknown modality earns no modality-qualified credit; temporal-only precision is reported separately. Neither is entailment or event-onset accuracy.
diagnostic_definitions.cost: Only observed finite nonnegative telemetry contributes. Missing fields remain null. Latency quantiles use linear interpolation at (n-1)*p; every distribution reports measured and missing counts. Counts include failed tool attempts where recorded. inspection_frames is selected model observations; decoded_frames is its retained legacy alias, not all codec work. raw_decoder_frames_decoded separately records codec decoding including seek preroll when available.
diagnostic_definitions.duplicate_frames: (selected inspection frame count - unique sampled timestamp count) / selected inspection frame count, only when both counts are observed and consistent. Zero selected frames and zero unique samples yield zero. Unobserved timestamps do not imply all frames were unique. This metric excludes codec seek preroll.
diagnostic_definitions.rates: Response failure and abstention rates use non-missing predictions as their denominator. operational_error_rate is a retained legacy alias of response_failure_rate, counting every status=error, including model/protocol rejection; it must not be described as infrastructure failure. error_breakdown separates terminal planner/format/evidence/time-policy/budget/model-protocol failures from backend and infrastructure exceptions; unknown provenance remains unknown. Tool failure rates use attempts with known ok/error outcomes. Format repair requires an explicitly classified format/validation rejection followed by another decision; unclassified errors leave that rate unknown. Decision-repair counts are reported separately.
diagnostic_definitions.budget: Hard limits are at most four attempted tools (or a stricter configured limit) and the configured selected-inspection-frame limit, default 16 model observations. Codec seek preroll can decode additional frames and is reported separately, not charged to this inspection budget. Reported counts are checked against trace counts; the larger tool count is used. Unknown telemetry cannot establish budget compliance.
diagnostic_definitions.joint_reviewed: Reasoning joint success requires a complete named semantic review, supported correct required/extra claims, and all required geometric supports. Event joint success requires an explicit boolean event-identity review and an explicit within-scope, modality-compatible timing prediction. Unreviewed quality remains null; citation times are never substituted for event predictions.

notes: Reasoning correctness comes only from named reviewer annotations; unknown judgments remain unknown. Missing/error/abstained answers are task failures.
Timestamp-search content uses the same named atomic review; temporal compliance uses recorded actual frames and cited source intervals separately. Sampled range evidence is not continuous coverage.
Support scores measure one-to-one citation geometry at IoU>=0.3, not semantic entailment; missing citation modalities are explicitly counted.
Onset scores require an explicit event prediction; citation starts and numbers in prose are never substituted.
Onset success uses distance of both predicted bracket endpoints to the uncertain reference bracket; wide brackets cannot win by containing everything.
All onset questions remain in success denominators. Absolute-error means are conditional, include wrong-occurrence errors, and expose measured counts.
ASR cue references measure transcript-cue localization, not verified word-level audio timing. Visual bracket precision is limited by its annotation width.
Event timing metrics do not establish semantic event identity without an explicit identity review. Reference-bracket coverage must be read together with bracket width and tolerance success.
This evaluator does not confer independence, blindness, human validation, or held-out status on the supplied data or reviews.
